# LogPage

A page of records that accumulate (target tracks, the import log, run history, attribution fixes): filter chips, a selectable table with bulk actions, an entry…

`SongNodes.LogPage` · Pages

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.LogPage records={…} state="loading" onAdd={…} />
```


## Props (LogPageProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `records` * | `TargetTrack[]` | Records, newest first. |
| `runs` | `RunLogEntry[]` | Append-only run history, newest first. |
| `nextRunAt` | `string` | Next scheduled run. |
| `state` * | `"loading" \| "ready" \| "refreshing" \| "error" \| "offline"` | Data state of the records region. |
| `onAdd` * | `(record: Omit<TargetTrack, "id" \| "state" \| "checksDone" \| "tracklistCount" \| "lastSearchedAt">) => Pro…` | Adds a record from the entry dialog. |
| `onAction` * | `(action: "active" \| "paused" \| "archived" \| "delete" \| "search", ids: number[]) => Promise<void>` | Bulk or row action; delete is confirmed in a ConfirmDialog first, archive offers Undo. |

### TargetTrack

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `number` | Stable ID; newest has the highest. |
| `artist` * | `string` | Artist as the label writes it. |
| `title` * | `string` | Title without the mix. |
| `genres` * | `string[]` | Genres from ChipInput. |
| `searchTerms` * | `string[]` | Extra spellings matched in tracklists. |
| `priority` * | `"critical" \| "high" \| "medium" \| "low"` | TaskPriority from the scraper orchestrator; shown via SongNodes.status(p, "priority"). |
| `state` * | `"active" \| "paused" \| "archived"` | Search state; archived rows are hidden unless "Show archived" is on. |
| `checksDone` * | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4` | How many of the 4 checks are done (found in tracklists, key, BPM, TIDAL link). |
| `missing` | `string` | What is still missing, in words ("key, TIDAL link"). |
| `tracklistCount` * | `number` | Appearances in scraped tracklists. |
| `lastSearchedAt` * | `string` | Last search of this track; stale (▲) after 8 days. |

| prop | type | note |
